title: Generic groundwater application orchestration — live application service
goal: Implement one topology-agnostic internal Python coupling-window service that drives the admitted Modflow6PreparedSolveSession and consumes a narrow SWAP runtime port shaped for F-GC49A plan outputs and F-GC49B participant handles.
design: service owns coupling-window control flow only and never raw XMI arrays or SWAP state

SWAP runtime port supplies immutable plan bindings/terms, origin capture, cell-head correctors, cell-level realized-groundwater flux evaluation, term reanchoring, candidate/ledger preflight and publication
service never reimplements F-GC40 reduction, F-GC33 evaluation/reanchoring or F-GC34 publication
convergence is conjunctive across MODFLOW and every cell residual; no cancelling global residual
nonfinal SWAP candidates are discarded while MODFLOW X continues from the same prepared solve and XOLD remains fixed
after successful finalize_time_step any SWAP/ledger publication failure is a hard durability invariant, not retry
exclusions: generic production FMR C ABI materialization
next_permitted_action: Implement production generic application service plus deterministic owner qualification and one live F-GC47 mixed-topology replay through a test-only runtime adapter. Independently verify no topology-specific branches or ownership leakage. If admitted, decide Stage D solely for generic production FMR ABI materialization.
implemented: fixed-capacity production registry sized by application context
non-recycling used slots and stale-handle rejection
external ownership pointers for backend, parameters, committed state and forcing materializer
immutable copied binding metadata for column, template, numerical configuration and datum
delegation to admitted fmr_groundwater_swap_participant_t for capture/trial/discard/preflight/commit
release fails closed while candidate is live
reinitialize fails while registrations remain active
owner_qualification: two real FMR handles over independent committed lineages
candidate isolation and nonmutating trial behavior

independent_qualification.claim: Source/ownership verifier proves committed state is referenced not copied, participant lifecycle is delegated, handles are nonrecycling/monotonic, and MODFLOW/ledger/solver ownership does not leak into registry.

admission_criteria: exact-head F-GC49B owner real-FMR qualification green
canonical delta reconciled without dependency conflict
production delta limited to participant registry

canonical_drift_reconciliation.disposition: Qualified Stage-B artifacts were overlaid unchanged on current canonical; owner and F-VQ122 evidence reused because no production dependency changed.

stage_b_admitted_capability: fixed-capacity generic FMR groundwater participant registry
multiple independent real FMR participants in one registry
external ownership references for backend/parameters/committed state/materializer
fail-closed busy release, stale handle and active reinitialize behavior
kernel remains sole committed-state mutation owner
reconcile_findings: No production Fortran MODFLOW/XMI solve surface exists; live prepared-solve ownership is intentionally Python in Modflow6PreparedSolveSession.
F-GC49A and F-GC49B are production Fortran capabilities but do not yet expose a generic cross-language application ABI.
F-GC44-F-GC47 C bridges remain qualification-only and must not become production architecture.
Therefore Stage C admits generic application-service control flow and a narrow runtime protocol; a separate Stage D is required if a generic production FMR C ABI remains absent after Stage C.
